categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet label present and modifies wallet signing and descriptor management in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents unbounded locked memory exhaustion by capping pending MuSig2 signing sessions per descriptor to 2048. Currently, unfinished sessions hold secret nonces in locked memory indefinitely until partial signatures are made or the wallet is unloaded, presenting a resource exhaustion risk during large or abandoned signing flows.
